text: The certificate exception event records the error category, protocol, port and UI at instrumented exception-acceptance paths. Configuration verification and CardDAV record before retrying, so the event does not establish a successful retry or login. Calendar records after acceptance even when there is no refreshable calendar. Coverage is limited to the instrumented call sites; the commit explicitly omits several other exception UIs. The schema uses string extras, while source fixtures contain both numeric and string ports; no generated conversion was checked. No event or test was executed.
title: Certificate exception events mark specific UI acceptance actions before retry completion
